# Mutating pg_cron calls (MUST be blocked)
cron.schedule('*/1 * * * *', 'DELETE FROM public.orders WHERE created_at < now() - interval ''30 days''');
cron.unschedule('cleanup-job');
cron.alter_job(1, schedule='* * * * *');

# DML/DDL via psql (MUST be blocked)
docker exec supabase-db psql -U postgres -d postgres -c "UPDATE cron.job SET active = false WHERE jobid = 1;"
docker exec supabase-db psql -U postgres -d postgres -c "INSERT INTO cron.job (schedule, command) VALUES ('*/5 * * * *', 'VACUUM');"
docker exec supabase-db psql -U postgres -d postgres -c "DROP TABLE public.audit_log;"
docker exec supabase-db psql -U postgres -d postgres -c "TRUNCATE public.events;"

# Out-of-scope read (non-allowed relation) (MUST be blocked)
docker exec supabase-db psql -U postgres -d postgres -c "SELECT * FROM public.users;"

# Dangerous CLI / secrets (MUST be blocked)
supabase functions deploy
docker restart supabase-db
docker compose up -d
docker compose down
pg_dump -U postgres -d postgres > backup.sql
cat .env
docker exec supabase-db psql -U postgres -d postgres -c "SELECT * FROM cron.job WHERE command LIKE '%JWT_SECRET=abcdef%';"
